verdict.rationale: Segment's Engage docs say Audiences can be built from computed traits, so computed traits exist on profiles and can be used for targeting and syncing to destinations. Predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are not documented; the only hint is a vague pricing-page line about 'AI‑powered audiences'. Missing for 10: documentation of predictive LTV/churn/purchase-propensity scores, detail on how computed traits are defined and calculated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: You can build Audiences from core tracking events, traits, and computed traits. You can then sync Audiences to hundreds of Destinations
Build AI‑powered audiences from a complete customer view
